design.title: Skyshard Drift
design.tagline: Climb the broken sky and wake the last beacon.
design.camera: Third-person orbit camera behind the hero, with mouse-look and soft collision against walls. It sits about 5 m back and 2 m up, and widens its FOV slightly while gliding.
design.artStyle: Stylized low-poly diorama look with hand-painted, softly gradated textures and no hard outlines. Faceted geometry is lit by a warm low sun with long soft shadows and cool blue ambient fill from the sky. Crystals and runes are emissive with a gentle bloom glow and floating motes. Distant islands fade into pastel atmospheric haze. The mood is serene, wondrous and a little melancholic, like a forgotten civilization drifting in golden-hour light. Textures are clean and painterly, with subtle brush grain, moss and weathering rather than photorealism, so every asset looks like part of the same storybook world.
design.setting: A shattered sky-realm where a temple city broke apart and its islands now drift above an endless cloud sea. Overgrown stairways, broken arches and rune-carved platforms are held aloft by glowing aether crystals, and a dormant beacon spire waits at the highest island.

hero.name: Ila the Skywalker
hero.description: A young explorer in a short teal cloak with a wind-scarf, leather satchel and goggles pushed up on her forehead. She is built from low-poly primitives (capsule body, sphere head, box satchel) and has a small glowing glider-charm on her wrist.

mechanics: Run, jump and double jump across floating islands. Falling into the cloud void respawns you at the last checkpoint rune and costs one life.
Glide: hold Jump in mid-air to slow the fall to a drifting descent. It drains a short stamina bar that refills on solid ground, so Ila can cross medium gaps between islands.
Collect 12 aether crystals, which glow and bob. Each pickup adds score and charges the beacon. Some crystals sit on risky detours, such as narrow beams or crumbling platforms.
Crumbling platforms: cracked stone tiles shake for 0.8 s after being stepped on, then fall away and respawn after a few seconds.
Stone Sentinels patrol set paths on the ruins. Touching one knocks Ila back and costs one life. They can be avoided by jumping over them or gliding past, and they never leave their islands.
Checkpoint runes activate when touched and save the respawn position. Wind updraft vents on some islands launch the glider upward to reach high crystals.
Once all 12 crystals are collected, the beacon gate at the top island opens. Reaching it wins the game.

controls.input: W A S D / Left stick

design.objective: Explore the floating ruins, collect all 12 aether crystals, then reach the beacon gate on the highest island to relight the sky.
design.loseCondition: Lose all 3 lives by falling into the cloud void or being struck by Stone Sentinels.
design.levelOutline: One handcrafted level of 5 islands linked by bridges, gaps and updrafts, rising in altitude. 1) Landing Isle (tutorial, safe): wide platform with 2 easy crystals, a low jump gap and a first checkpoint. Teaches jump and double jump. 2) Mossy Terraces: stepped ruins with 3 crystals, one slow Stone Sentinel and a first updraft vent that teaches gliding. 3) Cracked Causeway: a long chain of small crumbling platforms over the void with 3 crystals, one on a risky side beam. Second checkpoint at the start. 4) The Hollow Court: a ring-shaped ruin with 2 Sentinels patrolling opposite directions, 3 crystals, a vertical climb and a glide jump to the next island. Third checkpoint. 5) Beacon Spire: the final ascent over narrow beams and updrafts with 1 crystal on the way and the beacon gate at the top. The gate is locked until 12 crystals are held, and an earlier missed crystal means backtracking is allowed. Difficulty rises gradually: gaps widen from about 3 m to 8 m (the glide range), Sentinels appear from island 2, and crumbling tiles begin on island 3. Checkpoints sit before each hard section. The full run takes 6-10 minutes.

lines: The sky-city shattered, and its light fell silent.
Only the aether crystals still hum among the drifting ruins.
Ila climbs the broken sky to wake the last beacon.

direction.rationale: Skyshard Drift is a 3D vertical exploration game, and its core fantasy is looking up at a broken sky-city and climbing it. A continuous, rising camera tour through the five islands previews the ascent from the cloud sea to the beacon spire. Each narration line gets its own beat: shattered ruins, humming crystals, then Ila with her goal. This ends with a hand-off onto the real gameplay orbit camera
direction.mood: Epic, serene and wondrous, with a touch of melancholy. Golden-hour light over a forgotten civilization, with a swelling sense of scale.
direction.notes: Hero: Ila stands idle on the Landing Isle edge during the whole intro, with a subtle breathing loop, wind-scarf and cloak fluttering, and the wrist glider-charm pulsing softly. She is hidden or out of frame in shots 1-2 and is revealed in shot 3. Enemies: Stone Sentinels stay dormant, with eyes dark and no patrol, and are only glimpsed in the distance in shot 2. Crumbling tiles and updraft vents stay in their idle visuals only. Disable player input and HUD during the intro, and allow skipping wi

Fly in a low dolly past the Mossy Terraces and Cracked Causeway. Aether crystals pulse one after another with a soft hum, and the light travels along the floating chain of islands. Pass an inert Stone Sentinel in foreground silhouette, then slide behind a broken arch that frames
